card.name: Least or minimum amount in prescribing instructions
card.fires_on: Words like least, minimum, lowest and smallest right after prescribe the or and, introducing the amount, dose or duration to use. Found in label warnings about prescribing.

modes.label: Least/smallest amount
modes.description: A word meaning smallest quantity comes before number, amount or dose of tablets or drug.
modes.example: Prescribe the<< least>> number of tablets feasible to avoid intentional overdose

modes.label: Minimum durations
modes.description: The word minimum follows lowest effective dosages and before durations of combined use.
